customerMessage.text: How do I export my workspace data as a CSV?

kbSnapshot.text: Workspace data can be exported from Settings > Data > Export. Choose CSV or JSON, then confirm. Exports are emailed as a download link within a few minutes. On the Team plan, exports include all workspace tables; scheduled exports are available on Enterprise only.
Scheduled exports are an Enterprise-only feature. Team-plan workspaces export on demand only.

answer.text: Open Settings > Data > Export, choose CSV (or JSON), and confirm. The workspace data is emailed to you as a download link within a few minutes. On the Team plan exports include all workspace tables; scheduled exports are Enterprise-only, so on your plan you export on demand.

Scheduled exports are an Enterprise-only feature. Team-plan workspaces export on demand only.

customerMessage.text: We were charged twice for August and we are on a custom annual contract with a mid-year seat change. Can you tell me exactly how much we should be refunded, and refund it today?

kbSnapshot.text: Standard plans are billed monthly in advance. Mid-cycle seat changes are prorated on the next invoice.

A human with contract access must confirm the charge and own any refund; the employee must not compute amounts.
